items.prompt: This time tomorrow, I ___ to Madrid.
items.explain: Ação em andamento num momento do futuro: WILL BE + -ING.

items.prompt: ___ you be using the meeting room at 3?
items.explain: Pergunta educada sobre planos: WILL YOU BE + -ING?

items.prompt: By Friday, we ___ the audit.
items.explain: Concluído até um prazo (BY): WILL HAVE + particípio.

items.prompt: By 2030, the company ___ its emissions by half.
items.explain: BY + prazo: Future Perfect.

items.prompt: I ___ call you, but I got busy.
items.explain: Plano do passado que não se realizou: WAS GOING TO.

items.prompt: We ___ launch in May, but the project was delayed.
items.explain: 'Íamos' = WERE GOING TO.

items.prompt: We ___ for months before they finally agreed.
items.explain: Duração antes de um ponto do passado: HAD BEEN + -ING.

items.prompt: I'll call you as soon as I ___.
items.explain: Oração de tempo sobre o futuro: presente, não WILL.

items.prompt: We'll wait until he ___.
items.explain: UNTIL + presente com sentido de futuro.

items.prompt: Hurry! The meeting is ___ start.
items.explain: Prestes a: BE ABOUT TO.

items.prompt: The report is ___ on Friday.
items.explain: Previsto / com prazo: BE DUE.

items.prompt: Prices are ___ to rise next year.
items.explain: Provável: BE LIKELY TO.

items.prompt: I ___ at the gate when they announced the delay.
items.explain: Cenário da história: Past Continuous.

items.prompt: When I got to the office, everyone ___ home.
items.explain: O que veio antes na narrativa: Past Perfect.

items.prompt: When I was a kid, we ___ spend summers at the beach.
items.explain: Hábito repetido no passado: WOULD + verbo.

items.prompt: At 10 tomorrow, I ___ (present) the results to the board.
items.explain: Em andamento num momento futuro: WILL BE + -ING.

items.prompt: At 9 tomorrow I'll be work.
items.explain: WILL BE sempre com -ING.

items.prompt: By the end of the year, we ___ (review) every contract.
items.explain: BY + prazo: WILL HAVE + particípio.

items.prompt: By June we will finished the project.
options: By June we will have finished the project.
By June we will finishing the project.
By June we have will finished the project.
items.answer: By June we will have finished the project.
items.explain: Future Perfect: WILL HAVE + particípio.

items.prompt: I ___ (ia: send) it yesterday, but the system was down.
items.explain: 'Eu ia enviar' = WAS GOING TO + verbo.

items.prompt: I would call you yesterday, but I forgot.
options: I was going to call you yesterday, but I forgot.
I will call you yesterday, but I forgot.
I would have call you yesterday, but I forgot.
items.answer: I was going to call you yesterday, but I forgot.
items.explain: Plano do passado não realizado: WAS GOING TO.

items.prompt: She was tired because she ___ (work) all night.
items.explain: Duração antes de um ponto passado: HAD BEEN + -ING.

items.prompt: When I will finish, I'll call you.
options: When I finish, I'll call you.
When I'll finish, I call you.
When I finished, I'll call you.
items.answer: When I finish, I'll call you.
items.explain: Oração de tempo: presente, sem WILL.

items.prompt: Let me know as soon as you ___ (hear) from them.
items.explain: AS SOON AS + presente.

items.prompt: The report is previewed for Friday.
options: The report is due on Friday.
The report is previewed to Friday.
The report is due to Friday.
items.answer: The report is due on Friday.
items.explain: 'Previsto para' = DUE (ON + dia).

items.prompt: The flight is ___ (previsto) to land at 6.
items.explain: Previsto para: DUE TO / SCHEDULED TO.

items.prompt: I ___ (walk) to work when I saw the accident.
items.explain: Cenário: Past Continuous.

items.prompt: When we arrived, the presentation ___ (already / start).
items.explain: Anterior a outro passado: HAD + particípio.

items.prompt: I would live in Rio when I was young.
options: I used to live in Rio when I was young.
I would lived in Rio when I was young.
I was live in Rio when I was young.
items.answer: I used to live in Rio when I was young.
items.explain: Estado (live) no passado: só USED TO, não WOULD.

items.prompt: Every Sunday, my father ___ (would: cook) for the whole family.
items.explain: Hábito repetido: WOULD ou USED TO + verbo.

items.prompt: Don't call at 8. I ___ (have) dinner with a client.
items.explain: Em andamento no futuro: WILL BE + -ING.

items.prompt: By the time you arrive, I ___ (leave).
items.explain: Concluído antes de outro momento futuro.

items.prompt: In May, I ___ (work) here for 20 years.
items.explain: Duração até um ponto futuro: WILL HAVE + particípio.

items.prompt: We had ___ (wait) for over an hour when the CEO finally arrived.
items.explain: HAD BEEN + -ING.

items.prompt: Once the contract ___ (sign), we'll start onboarding.
items.explain: Oração de tempo: presente (ou present perfect), também na passiva.

items.prompt: The new rules are ___ (provável) to affect small suppliers.
items.explain: BE LIKELY TO.

items.prompt: I was ___ (prestes a) leave when the phone rang.
items.explain: WAS ABOUT TO.

items.prompt: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase correta.
items.answer: By Friday we will have finished the audit.
items.explain: BY + prazo: Future Perfect.

items.prompt: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase correta.
items.answer: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
items.explain: WAS GOING TO: plano não realizado.

items.prompt: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase correta.
items.answer: I'll let you know as soon as I hear from them.
items.explain: AS SOON AS + presente.

items.prompt: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase correta.
items.answer: The flight had already left when we arrived.
items.explain: Past Perfect para o que veio antes.

items.prompt: Qual frase está correta?
options: I'll call you when I get there.
I'll call you when I'll get there.
I call you when I will get there.
items.answer: I'll call you when I get there.
items.explain: WHEN + presente; WILL só na oração principal.

items.prompt: Qual frase está correta?
options: She was going to resign, but they offered her a raise.
She would resign, but they offered her a raise yesterday.
She will resign, but they offered her a raise.
items.answer: She was going to resign, but they offered her a raise.
items.explain: Plano interrompido: WAS GOING TO.

items.prompt: Qual frase está correta?
options: We used to have an office in Lisbon.
We would have an office in Lisbon.
We were used to have an office in Lisbon.
items.answer: We used to have an office in Lisbon.
items.explain: Estado passado (have): USED TO.

items.prompt: Qual frase descreve uma ação em andamento num momento futuro?
options: This time next week, I'll be lying on a beach.
Next week, I lie on a beach.
Next week, I'll have lain on a beach.
items.answer: This time next week, I'll be lying on a beach.
items.explain: WILL BE + -ING.
